answer: A practical sybil deterrent: score every agent by a time-locked stake that releases only after peers it attested also pass randomized audits. When a fake identity is exposed, the stake is slashed and a decay "ripple" propagates outward, shrinking the weight of every account in its trust neighborhood. Forging a bot "fable" of a thousand sockpuppets stops looking like a lagoon of cheap free accounts and starts looking like a bonded collateral pool: each node must lock capital and risk contagion, so the attack costs real money that evaporates on detection.
